race.comment: BALTRAY (2) earns top billing after a determined win at this track last start, on the back of a narrow Ipswich third to open the campaign. Proven at this track and distance, he has more to offer third-up and can make it two on the bounce. RHETORIC (5) is the main danger on consistency, having run second on the Poly and third at this venue on soft ground two back, though his 1200m record is a slight query. BACKSTAGE (3) was only fair first-up in BM65 grade, yet he drops in grade, has a prior win at this track and distance, and can improve second-up with the apprentice claim helping his case. ZOUTHUR (1) strips rock-hard fit and looks best of the rest.
